initial_interpretation: Select the largest radius tile that seats without force.
observation: The tile is a square with an increasing lower-left cutaway. Larger nominal radius removes more material and is therefore progressively looser in the same rounded drawer corner.
corrected_rule: Select the smallest tile that seats without force while both tangent legs contact; the next smaller tile is the interference bound and the next larger tile is the clearance bound.
limitations: This proves selection direction for this cutaway-tile geometry; physical seating, daylight judgment and user repeatability remain deferred.
